home.title: Turn your phone credit into cash
home.subtitle: Send us your credit and we add the money to your balance. Withdraw it by D17, Flouci or money order.
home.step1Text: You see how much money you get before you start.
home.step2Text: We give you a number and a code. Just tap and call.
home.step3Text: The money goes to your balance. Withdraw it any time.
home.trustText: We only count the credit we really received, checked twice.
home.exampleSend: If you send {amount} DT of credit
home.ratesLine: If you send {amount} DT of credit, you get:

login.title: Welcome to {brand}
login.subtitle: Sign in to sell your credit and follow your payments.

sell.title: Sell credit
sell.subtitle: Fill in the details. The rate is locked when you start and the money goes to your balance once the transfer is confirmed.
sell.sender: Your phone number (the one sending the credit)
sell.senderHint: 8 digits. We use it to recognise your transfer.
sell.payoutMethod: How do you want to be paid?
sell.rateLockNote: The rate shown is locked when you press Start.
sell.balanceNote: Once the transfer is confirmed, the amount is added to your balance. You can sell several times and withdraw everything in one go from the Balance page.
sell.q1: Which operator is your credit on?
sell.q2: How much {operator} credit do you want to sell?
sell.dinarsNotMillimes: Write in dinars (DT), not millimes. Example: write 10 for 10 dinars, or 2.5 for 2 dinars 500.
sell.bigAmountWarning: Careful: you wrote {amount} DT. That is a lot! Amounts are in dinars, not millimes.
sell.q3: Which number will send the {operator} credit?
sell.q3Hint: The phone number that has the credit. 8 digits.

sale.title: Sale {ref}
sale.queuedText: All our {operator} numbers are busy. You're number {position} in line — this page updates by itself.
sale.assigningText: We are checking the number before showing it. This takes a few seconds.
sale.sendText: Use the {operator} transfer code below from the number {sender}.
sale.ooredooHint: After dialing, follow the menu and enter the amount when asked.
sale.expiresHint: The number is reserved for you until the timer ends.
sale.verifyingText: We received the operator's message. We are confirming it on the SIM balance.
sale.partialTitle: We received only part of the amount
sale.partialText: Confirmed {received} DT out of {declared} DT. {missing} DT are missing.
sale.partialTopupText: Send the remaining {missing} DT to the same number before the timer ends. If you don't, the sale is completed with the amount received.
sale.reviewText: Something needs a manual check. Our team will review your transfer shortly — no action is needed from you.
sale.successText: We received {amount} DT of credit. {net} DT have been added to your balance.
sale.expiredText: We didn't receive any credit within the reserved time. If you sent credit late, it will be reviewed by our team.
sale.rejectedText: This sale was rejected after review. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
sale.cancelConfirmText: Only cancel if you have NOT sent any credit. Credit sent after cancelling may not be recovered automatically.
sale.successTextLegacy: We received {amount} DT of credit. We will send you {net} DT by {method} as soon as possible.
sale.sendFrom: Send it from your number {sender}. Another number will not work.
sale.step1Mobile: Tap the green “Send now” button below.
sale.step1Desktop: On your phone, dial the code shown below.
sale.step2Call: Your phone opens with the code ready. Press call.
sale.step3Amount: When the menu asks for the amount, type {amount} DT and confirm.
sale.stepWait: Stay on this page. It updates by itself when we receive the credit.

sales.title: My sales
sales.subtitle: Follow each sale and its payment.
sales.emptyText: Sell your first credit in a couple of minutes.

events.topup_chosen: You chose to send the rest
events.confirmed: Sale confirmed — {net} DT added to your balance
events.expired_partial: Time expired — completed with the received amount
events.queue_timeout: No number became free in time
events.late_credit: Late transfer of {amount} DT received — under review

errors.operator_unavailable: This operator is not available right now.
errors.payout_method_unavailable: This payout method is not available.
errors.payout_phone_invalid: The payout phone number is invalid.
errors.payout_below_fee: The amount is too small to cover the payout fee.
errors.sender_busy: There is already an active sale for this sender number.
errors.cannot_cancel: This sale can no longer be cancelled.
errors.invalid_state: This action is not possible anymore.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.below_minimum: The amount is below the minimum withdrawal.
errors.insufficient_balance: Your balance is not enough for this amount.

wallet.title: My balance
wallet.subtitle: Money from your confirmed sales. Withdraw it whenever you want.
wallet.pendingHint: Already requested, being sent by our team.
wallet.withdrawText: Minimum {min} DT per withdrawal. The fee of the chosen method is deducted once per withdrawal.
wallet.needMinimum: You need at least {amount} DT on your balance to request a withdrawal.
wallet.noMethods: No withdrawal method is available right now.
wallet.requested: Withdrawal requested. We will send it as soon as possible.
wallet.noEntries: Nothing yet. Your confirmed sales will appear here.
